title: Add mounted guards after async gaps in widgets
objective: Guard setState and dialog/navigation side effects that occur after awaits with mounted checks.
acceptance_criteria: Every setState call that can execute after an await is guarded by if (!mounted) return or an equivalent mounted branch
Every showDialog/navigation context use after an await is guarded by mounted or context.mounted as appropriate
Synchronous setState handlers are not unnecessarily refactored
Existing UI behavior remains unchanged except preventing disposed-widget side effects
flutter analyze lib/ui/ reports no new use_build_context_synchronously or setState-after-dispose related warnings
deliverables: Mounted guards in affected StatefulWidget files
